configuration.source: Parv Modi, Automotive Vehicles Engine Health Dataset, Kaggle, version 1 (2023). The user-supplied engine_data.csv was verified byte-for-byte against the public download on 2 November 2026. Collection protocol and pressure/temperature units remain unverified.
configuration.label_note: The healthy/faulty mapping remains unverified because external sources conflict. This report retains class 0/class 1 terminology throughout. Class 1 is the positive class solely for statistical evaluation; it does not imply healthy, faulty, or better condition.

label_evidence.title: Original dataset: Parv Modi, Automotive Vehicles Engine Health Dataset, Kaggle, version 1 (2023)
label_evidence.finding: The downloaded CSV exactly matches the supplied file. The retrieved source metadata does not define the target-class meanings.

label_evidence.title: Hossein Nafar, master thesis, University of Wuppertal (2024), printed page 30 / PDF page 41
label_evidence.finding: Describes class 1 as healthy and class 0 as out of operation or failed; reference 47 cites the matching Kaggle dataset.

label_evidence.title: Jayden P. Chen, Fusion of Neural Networks and Logistic Regression for Predictive Maintenance of Vehicle Engines (2024), Table 1, page 66
label_evidence.finding: Describes class 1 as indicating a need for maintenance. Its sensor summary statistics match this dataset, although its stated row count differs.
